name: Mizuha Ayane
source:
Daughter of former manager of big corporation who lost his position to someone else in the internal power struggle. Despite having boyfriend she is still virgin.

[spoiler]After knowing protagonist's hypnosis power she deals with him to help her father to return to his position in exchange for her body.[/spoiler]
